messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: rstan installation problems on Ubuntu
parts:
On Wednesday, September 9, 2015 at 10:43:39 AM UTC-4, Bill Gillespie wrote:
   Welcome to Metworx!

These welcome messages mess up rstan 2.7.0-1. The easiest thing is probably to set the environmental variables R_PROFILE_USER and R_PROFILE_SITE to non-existent files before trying to install rstan from CRAN

Sys.setenv(R_PROFILE_USER = "foobar")
Sys.setenv(R_PROFILE_SITE = "foobar")

Then you can restart R and it should find your .Rprofile files again. If that doesn't work, then it is possible to install the development versions of everything. Or if you can wait a few days, new versions will be on CRAN.

Ben
